name: NEET no Ore wa Miteiru Koto shika Dekinai
original_name: ニートの俺は見ていることしか出来ない
source:
The protagonist, having failed his job hunt, has turned into a NEET.
His daily routine consists of nothing but eating and sleeping.
When he looks at his phone, he notices that guy has started posting on social media.
Meanwhile, his mother is gradually growing more and more distant…​

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01657800.html/]DLsite[/url]]
